t: The UK took its present form in 1922, when the Irish Free State left and Northern Ireland stayed in the union.
It fought both world wars to victory, standing alone against Nazi Germany in 1940, but emerged exhausted and in debt.
After 1945 it built a welfare state, gave up its empire, joined and then left the European Union.
dyk: The country's full name changed only in 1927: from 1922 to 1927 it was still officially the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.
ev: The Irish Free State leaves; Northern Ireland remains in the United Kingdom
Dunkirk evacuation and the Battle of Britain; Churchill becomes Prime Minister
The National Health Service is founded

Hong Kong is handed over to China
